howToUpdate: Fortnite replay tags name weapons by internal codename (e.g. Weapon.Ranged.Pistol.Slingshot.HarmlessThrift), not by the name players see. Each entry lists codename pieces to look for in the tag after 'Weapon.Ranged.'; matching ignores case, dots and underscores, and the longest match wins. When Meter Checker shows only a class name like 'Pistol', hover the weapon to see its tag, add an entry here, and release a new version. Ammo 'Heavy' or sniper=true makes a final kill count as an automatic trickshot.
